name: Z.ai / GLM (Standard & Coding Plan)
author: DJLegends
description: Adds two connection kinds for Z.ai / Zhipu AI: "Z.ai / GLM Coding Plan" (api/coding/paas/v4) for Coding Plan subscriptions and "Z.ai / GLM Standard API" (api/paas/v4) for pay-as-you-go keys. Supports GLM thinking mode (reasoning_content), automatic sampler clamping, Zhipu error code translation (1113 quota, 1302 concurrency), and Global (api.z.ai) or Mainland China (open.bigmodel.cn) regions.
